summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC furnishing the final detailed voting map from its Extraordinary General Meeting held on August 18, 2026. The filing consolidates votes cast at a distance and in person on seven items, listing shareholder CPF/CNPJ identifiers, shareholdings, and vote choices for each item. This is a routine post-meeting disclosure required under CVM Resolution No. 81/22. No corporate action, transaction, or special situation is described; it merely reports voting results on unspecified meeting resolutions. Accordingly, this filing does not constitute a special-situation event and is classified as none.
